overview: The commission reviewed ongoing maintenance projects, including bathroom lighting upgrades and gym floor water mitigation, and discussed upcoming grant cycles for capital improvements.

items.title: Facility Maintenance Updates
items.summary: Bathroom LED lighting installation is scheduled to begin immediately, and a contractor has been identified for balcony egress lighting repairs.

items.title: Financial Report
items.summary: Members reviewed mitigation and restoration fund balances, noting the recurring $100,000 annual revenue from the Encore surrounding community agreement.

items.title: Promotional Video
items.summary: The commission discussed a YouTube feature produced by a former board member to be used as a marketing tool for the theatre and Medford Square.

items.title: Friends of Chevalier Annual Meeting
items.summary: The annual meeting was announced for October 22nd at 7:00 PM, featuring local program updates and a presentation by the poet laureate.

items.title: Gymnasium Water Infiltration
items.summary: Severe water issues caused by a high water table have damaged the gym floor, requiring recreation programs to seek alternative sites.

items.title: Grant Applications
items.summary: Community Preservation Act applications for building assessments and stormwater mitigation are currently under review by the city.

items.title: Project Status Reports
items.summary: Updates were provided on stair carpeting, marquee installation coordination, and a diesel tank replacement scheduled for late October.

items.title: Organ Restoration
items.summary: Wurlitzer organ restoration work has resumed, and the commission scheduled an open house for the organ chamber on November 7th.

items.title: State Grant Opportunities
items.summary: The commission discussed new guidelines and upcoming deadlines for the Mass Cultural Council and the Gaming Commission's Community Mitigation Fund.

items.title: Meeting Rescheduling
items.summary: The next meeting was rescheduled to November 18th to avoid a conflict with the Veterans Day holiday.
